scenes.title: Your AI content sounds like **everyone else's.**
scenes.voice: Your AI content sounds like everyone else's. Here's how to fix it.

scenes.title: Give AI a **brand pack**
scenes.voice: AI sounds generic when it knows nothing about your brand. So give it a brand pack.

scenes.title: One page:
scenes.voice: One page. Who you speak to. Your voice in three words. Words you use, and words you never use.

scenes.title: Add 3–5 examples of your **best work**
scenes.voice: Then add three to five examples of your best work. Examples matter more than rules.

scenes.title: Save it once. Every draft starts **on-brand.**
scenes.voice: Save it once in your AI tool, so every draft starts on-brand.

scenes.title: Before you publish:
items: Would we put our name on it?
scenes.voice: Before you publish, check. Does it sound like us? Are the facts right? Would we put our name on it?
